fields.label: Home — Headline
fields.name: home_title
fields.instructions: Wrap part of the headline in *asterisks* to give it the rose/plum italic accent. e.g. write your *own story*
fields.default_value: Take control of your life and write your *own story*.

fields.label: Home — Intro paragraph
fields.name: home_lead
fields.default_value: The Her Tribe is a women-led community for financial literacy, career mentorship, workshops, and personal growth — a circle of women lifting each other forward.

fields.label: About — Intro paragraph
fields.name: about_lead
fields.default_value: The Her Tribe began with a simple belief: every woman deserves a community that helps her thrive — financially, professionally, and personally.

fields.label: Programs — Intro paragraph
fields.name: programs_lead
fields.default_value: Three pathways — career, money, and well-being — plus Tribe Talk, our open space for honest conversation. Come for the skills, stay for the community.

fields.label: Contact — Intro paragraph
fields.name: contact_lead
fields.default_value: Whether you want to join the community, ask about a program, or share your own story as a mentor — we'd love to hear from you.
